evidence_policy.version_change: invalidate TRUE evidence depending on changed subject; never clear a known failure
evidence_policy.READY: observation only; every action reevaluates its own full conditions atomically
evidence_policy.unknown_reason: Численные окна валидности/датчики REV не определены
evidence_policy.resource_scope: RESOURCES revision changes on any required consumer availability change, not only hydraulic supply; each proof is specific to the action
evidence_policy.failure_scope: Physical/material failures persist by subject; EVENT_FRESH rejection is scoped to the failed operation_id and is never reused for that ID. A new recovery operation may use fresh evidence; material identity conflicts remain latched LEDGER_VALID failures.
